title: Ryan Studio whiteboard (content process step 0)
description: Written by the ad-strategist (.claude/agents/ad-strategist.md) before anyone builds, as whiteboard.json in the brief's own folder. The brief step refuses a brief without one and holds its script to the plain-English rules (lib/content/process/plain-english.ts, rules R-186 to R-191). Check it with: npm run studio -- whiteboard <whiteboard.json> <brief-or-numbers.json> [--ad]. Matt 2026-10-14.

author.description: Always the ad-strategist. A builder never writes the whiteboard.

audience.description: Who this is for, in plain words, the way the opening line will call them out ("People thinking of buying a home in Central Oregon"). A creative label, never a targeting field; describe a situation, never who should live somewhere (fair housing).

context.description: What is happening, in plain words a 75-year-old follows on first hearing. The opening line shares words with this field or with audience (R-191).

insight.description: The thing a buyer or seller has not heard from their other broker friends.

contrast.description: What came before, only when figures back it; null when none do.

figures.description: The figure IDs that back the contrast; each is also listed in figures.

why_now.description: Why act now. A date or a duration is a figure: name its basis or write the condition instead (CLAUDE.md §0).

why_us.description: Why Ryan Realty: what we do that the viewer gets (VOICE.md). No "top team".

ask.description: The one thing the viewer does next.

script.description: The read-aloud lines, in order. Line 1 names the audience or the situation. Any figure typed here is the on_screen value of a brief.numbers row listed in figures (R-187).

figures.description: Figure IDs only (brief.numbers keys), never typed numbers.

takes_killed.description: Five takes were written; four were killed. One line each on why. The count and the length are PLAIN_ENGLISH.takesKilled and maxReasonChars in lib/content/process/plain-english.ts (a test holds this schema to them).
